source.basis: Official campus block diagram and building index. The public diagram is schematic and does not provide a surveyed coordinate frame or metric building footprints.

units: metres for simulation only; coordinates/footprints below are estimated by tracing the published schematic, not survey measurements

model.wheel_track_status: estimate: replace with measured wheel-center spacing
model.wheel_radius_status: estimate: replace with measured loaded radius
model.box_dimensions_status: PLACEHOLDER: exact CAS Box enclosure dimensions not supplied
model.lidar_angle_convention: bin 0 forward; bins increase clockwise; confirm sensor offset from actual firmware settings
model.ultrasonic_angles_status: simulation defaults; measure actual sensor directions

paved_walkways.name: B south exit to central walkway

start.description: Approximate south-side exit at Block B from diagram; verify actual building exit on site

goal.description: Simulated stop point just north of Block H footprint; this is an outdoor building-approach goal, not an interior room target

mapping_notes: The public THD map labels the buildings, but it does not supply coordinates or metric scale. Geometry is an approximate traced schematic for simulation and must be calibrated with measured site distances or GIS data.
Building positions use centre x/y plus width/height. In simulation, the path planner inflates building footprints by the rover's circumscribed radius plus a safety margin.

Only rover chassis length 0.30 m and total width 0.20 m are treated as known. Wheel track/radius, box enclosure dimensions, sensor offsets, and ultrasonic bearings remain explicitly editable estimates.

The route from Block B to Block H is an initial candidate based on the published block diagram, not a verified pedestrian route. Access gates, steps, ramps, roads, landscaping and obstacles are not fully represented.
The reported indoor LiDAR dataset is not the outdoor campus terrain. It provides indoor landmark signatures, not campus pose or metric coordinates.
The simulator's Block H goal stops at an approximate external approach point. It should not automatically navigate inside a building without an indoor map and authorized route.
